title: Label Comparison — Economic Alignment
hypothesis: A label that combines volatility expansion with minimum absolute magnitude (ATR80 filter embedded in the target) will produce a better trading classifier than the current relative-only label (ATR[t+12] > ATR[t] × 1.05).
null_hypothesis: All candidate labels produce equivalent trading performance — the current label's bias toward low-ATR states is not economically significant.
description: Compare 4 candidate labels head-to-head using walk-forward validation. Each label trains its own classifier. All other strategy parameters (features, threshold, entry/exit rules) are held constant. Measures whether a more economically-aligned label improves trading outcomes.

labels.name: relative_5pct
labels.description: Current label. Relative expansion only. Easy to satisfy at low ATR.

labels.name: relative_5pct_min_abs_atr
labels.definition: ATR[t+12] > ATR[t] × 1.05 AND ATR[t+12] - ATR[t] > ATR[t] × 0.50
labels.description: Adds minimum absolute ATR expansion requirement (50% of current ATR). Filters out small expansions at low ATR.

labels.name: relative_10pct
labels.description: Harder relative threshold. Reduces low-ATR bias by requiring larger % move.

labels.name: mfe_threshold
labels.description: Direct MFE target: actual price must move ≥1% within 12 candles AND volatility must expand. Aligns label with minimum tradable move.

entry_gates: prob >= 0.55 AND btc_trend >= 0.002 AND close > EMA50

output.label_comparison_table: per-label metrics across all pairs and folds
